messages:
nina_sales: Quick one — Customer 'AtlasHealth' is asking for a migration credit as part of a 12mo Dedicated commit. They want 35% credit on first 3 months to offset infra migration costs. asking if we can approve.

ravi_se: Context: this is a net-new account, expected first-year committed spend ~$220k. They require Private deployment + data residency. POC already done, outcome positive.

ethan_finance: 35% is above typical. Our standard migration credit is up to 20% for Year 1 on ARR-like commits. We can stretch to 25% with a 12mo commit + prepay. Need margin calc.

morgan_dealdesk: @nina_sales please attach ARR calc and any concessions (free POC, professional services credits). If ARR >= $200k we can escalate to CRO for one-off. Also need deal terms (prepay vs monthly).

jules_csm: Heads up — Atlas wants SOC2 in the contract annex and a data processing addendum. That adds legal review time; worth noting to the customer.

nina_sales: Attachments: `commit_breakdown.xlsx` (sent offline). Asking if we can combine: 25% migration credit + $15k professional services credit. Customer will sign 12mo prepay. Can we get CRO exception for extra 10%?

ethan_finance: If they prepay 12mo and fund >= $220k, finance can approve 30% total credit (25% migration + PS credit valued at ~5%) but requires Deal Desk + CRO signoff and legal OK on DPA/SLA.

sanjay_revops: Created internal approval ticket DD-5678 and routed to @morgan_dealdesk and @olga_legal. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DD-5678

morgan_dealdesk: I can kick to CRO for one-off. Need explicit statement that PS credit is non-recurring and POC waived. Also require a minimal contract language: `migration_credit_applies_first_90_days`.

olga_legal: I reviewed the DPA request. We can accept standard DPA + SOC2 sig. No blockers but timeline ~7 business days for annex. Will add SLA addendum; will need customer countersign.

nina_sales: Thanks — I'll confirm prepay and ask customer to accept DPA template. Planning to push CRO approval today.

dealbot: Approval request submitted to CRO queue (PRIORITY: high) — ticket DD-5678. Estimated decision window 24-48h. :white_check_mark:

morgan_dealdesk: Noted. If CRO approves, finance to finalize credit memo and legal to attach DPA. Keep thread updated.

nina_sales: Will do. tagging customer execs for visibility once approved. :rocket:
